source.description: Small, manually curated reference inventory derived from public Workday documentation. NOT a complete Workday export, exact tenant configuration, or canonical MDE definitions.
source.access: Public documentation reviewed 2026-10-14. Follow upstream licensing and access restrictions before redistributing catalog spreadsheets or WSDL/XSD files.

records.name: Worker
records.notes: Documented Workday business object; confirm definition, worker categories and effective dating against downloadable catalog.

records.name: Position
records.notes: Documented Workday business object; confirm position/job distinction.

records.name: Supervisory Organization
records.notes: Workday-specific structure; do not collapse into generic organizational unit without semantic review.

records.name: Business Process Definition
records.notes: Configurable step and role definition; organizational overrides/inheritance.

records.name: Business Process Event
records.notes: A running business process instance/event; distinct from the reusable process definition.

records.name: Security Group
records.notes: Steps route to members of security groups rather than hard-coded individuals.

records.name: Hire Worker
records.notes: Initiated by an authorized role; includes configurable tasks and compensation proposal. Example behavior, not an exhaustive prescribed workflow.

records.name: Supplier Invoice Processing
records.notes: Workday financial BP example; details of tenant approval policies are not public universal rules.

records.name: Approval Step
records.notes: Approve, deny, or send back according to process configuration. Behavior derived from public framework documentation.

records.name: Approval Chain
records.notes: May traverse management hierarchy subject to an exit condition.

records.name: Conditional Step Routing
records.notes: Conditional step execution based on configured business conditions.

records.name: Business Process Notifications
records.notes: Trigger at event or step transitions; recipient determination follows configurations.

records.name: Organization-Specific Process Definition
records.notes: Child organization may inherit or override superior organization's process definition.

records.name: Role-Based Process Routing
records.notes: Authorized initiators and step assignees resolved through security groups and context.

records.name: Business Process Event Tracking
records.notes: Process event traceability and audit history.
